parts.t: Abbotsford East includes the McKee mountainside neighbourhood, historic Clayburn Village, Whatcom and the Abbotsford Recreation Centre, with Sumas Mountain trails close by. This is an MLS® area with no official City boundary, so schools and parks here are placed by address.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 10, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Abbotsford.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

parts.t: The McKee plan guides new homes on the mountainside.
The McKee Neighbourhood Plan (Bylaw 3400-2023) was adopted June 26, 2023. It combines homes, schools, parks and trails into one complete neighbourhood.
Immel-McMillan, east of Historic Downtown, mixes residential densities and commercial uses, with three Neighbourhood Centres.
The Official Community Plan is Bylaw 2600-2016.
